Ben —

Thanks for the recap and the attachments. Putting numbers together from product / infra:

- Expected monthly token volume: our best estimate is 80M–120M tokens / month during year-1 ramp (conservative baseline ~80M; optimistic ~120M).
- Typical tokens per request: ~250 tokens average (prompt 80 tokens + completion 170 tokens).
- Steady-state TPS: ~12 TPS during business hours;
- Peak TPS: spikes to ~30–35 TPS during major notification batches / marketing pushes.
- Budget range: initial budget $8k–$12k / month for hosted API (we may expand if unit economics prove out).
- Target unit cost: looking for ~$10–$15 per 1M tokens to be workable for our business case.

A couple of clarifying notes: some requests are longer (conversational threads) and can push avg tokens/request to ~400 on heavier flows — that's probably 10% of traffic. We'd like to understand potential cost/speed tradeoffs (e.g., model quantization, batching settings) under those scenarios.

Happy to jump back on a quick call if you need more granularity on request mix.

Regards,
Samir
Head of Product, FintechCo
samir@fintechco.com
